characteristics: THE VISUAL FIELD MAY OCCUPY A SIDE
MAIN CONTENT NEED NOT ALIGN TO THE NAV WIDTH

use_for: EVERY SCREEN THAT CARRIES THE 5-ITEM PRODUCT NAV: FAMILY ROOTS, FUNCTIONAL CHILD SCREENS, DECISION SCREENS, ACCOUNT
characteristics: THE FUNCTIONAL FIELD IS CENTRED ON THE `+` AXIS
THE FIELD SHARES THE NAV FOOTPRINT ON PHONES (--jrn-stage-w = --jrn-nav-w)
TEXT INSIDE THE FIELD KEEPS ITS OWN ALIGNMENT — THE FIELD IS CENTRED, NOT EVERY ELEMENT
BACKGROUND FRAMES THE FIELD FROM THE PERIMETER (focal anchoring + calm layer)
FAMILY ARCHETYPES KEEP THEIR OWN INTERNAL RHYTHM

detection.rule: resolveCompositionMode({ screenId, hasProductNav, override }) → override ?? COMPOSITION_OVERRIDES[screenId] ?? (hasProductNav ? CENTER_STAGE : EDGE_LED)
detection.explicit_contract_not_css_hack: JurnlScreen renders data-jrn-composition; JurnlFamilyFrame passes productNav = (nav prop present); direct JurnlScreen users with the nav (F04 ACTIVITY, parent authority fallback) pass productNav.
detection.documented_exceptions: NONE. Every nav-bearing screen is CENTER_STAGE; an override must carry a written reason (enforced by tests/jurnlCenterStage.test.tsx).

enforcement.unit: tests/jurnlCenterStage.test.tsx — 59 tests: every product route renders the nav AND CENTER_STAGE; every F01/F02 route renders no nav AND EDGE_LED; overrides need a reason; CSS geometry contract.
enforcement.live: scripts/jurnl/center-stage-qa.mjs — declared mode + measured geometry on every material route at 5 widths.

overlays: Sheets / drawers / modals keep their own overlay contract (sprint §48); they render in the overlay host, outside the CENTER_STAGE field.
no_nav_child_pages: None exist today. A child page that drops the product nav for a focused task may use EDGE_LED or another approved mode (sprint §50) — it resolves to EDGE_LED automatically because it has no nav.
